{{Youmay|a ground-based vehicle type|a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] or the [[Carrier (speedball)|speedball position]]}}
{{Quote|All troop carriers will assemble at the north entrance.|[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
A '''troop carrier''' referred to any number of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] vehicles used to quickly transport [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the ground.

==History==
Troop carrier models included the [[Reconnaissance Troop Transporter]] and the [[Rebel personnel carrier/Legends|Rebel personnel carrier]].
